title: Children's Museum of Richmond

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Both formats have programs designed for preschools, elementary schools, daycares, and homeschool groups. If you’d like to enjoy the museum without an educational program, just request a Group Visit at either of our two locations. All of our school programs align to current Virginia standards (Virginia’s Early Learning and Development Standards and/or Virginia Standards of Learning), and each is designed to support the learning priorities of our Learning Framework.
